lemma_four_clause_invariance.name: AT_MOST_FOUR_CLAUSES_IS_INVARIANT_UNDER_FROZEN_ORDINARY_ELIMINATION
lemma_four_clause_invariance.statement: Let a continuing canonical CNF state contain m<=4 clauses. For any live Davis-Putnam pivot x, write p,q,r for the numbers of positive-x, negative-x and retained clauses. Before duplicate/subsumption cleanup, the distinct raw output has at most r+p*q<=m<=4 clauses. Unit propagation and canonicalization cannot increase this count. Therefore every continuing ordinary successor also has at most four clauses.
proof: At most p*q resolvents can be generated; tautologies and duplicates only reduce the distinct raw count.

Frozen unit propagation/restriction removes satisfied clauses, shortens others, and canonicalization removes duplicates/subsumed clauses; none creates additional clauses beyond the exact restricted residual.

lemma_four_clause_raw_cap.name: FOUR_CLAUSE_STATE_MAKES_EVERY_ORDINARY_PIVOT_N2_SAFE
lemma_four_clause_raw_cap.statement: In a state with n live variables and m<=4 clauses, exact elimination of any pivot has monotone distinct raw state_units <=1+4*n. Hence for N>=5 and n<=N, every pivot is safe under the frozen N^2 cap.
proof: After eliminating one pivot, every nonempty raw clause is over at most n-1 variables, so each charged clause contributes at most 1+(n-1)=n state units.
The four-clause invariant bounds the number of distinct raw clauses by four.

N25_application.prior_frontier: The T/Signed-LYM/unique-raw combination had only N=25,r0=10 uncertified.
root_accounting: For a legitimate nonempty root, N=state_units(root)+r0=1+m+L+r0.
Full variable coverage gives L>=10, so m<=4.
consequence: If an earlier exact lane or unit propagation terminates, no rescue is needed.
Otherwise the first ordinary stage has at most four clauses; unit propagation cannot raise that count.
Every ordinary elimination preserves the <=4-clause invariant and every pivot is raw-cap safe because n<=10 and RAW_x<=41<625.
Live variables strictly decrease under ordinary elimination until an earlier exact terminal lane applies; v2/v3 cannot be required for lack of raw-cap availability.

range_theorem.name: NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N25
range_theorem.statement: For every legitimate root with N<=25, the frozen solver cannot require v2/v3 solely because ordinary exact elimination lacks N^2 raw-cap availability. N<=24 is inherited from the unique-raw-universe theorem; the only previously uncertified N25 root-variable case r0=10 is discharged by the four-clause invariant.
